selectionReason: The next fifteen, in source-row order, of the absent frozen rows at least one of whose KANJIDIC2 readings is used by an existing word article that declares the kanji (an automatic alignment of each word's kana against the kanji's readings), the rule announced on issue 60 after batch 136. No word article is added: 17 existing articles each gain one link to a new card. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list. All fifteen pass, so none is set aside. Three existing cards (張 慢 修) also change in one remark each: a sentence that said the kanji had no card here now links it. 91 rows of the 106-row group, 11 rows whose declaring articles use none of their KANJIDIC2 readings, and 644 rows with no declaring article remain.
